name: ServiceNow MCP Server
description: Enables Claude to interact with ServiceNow instances through the ServiceNow API, allowing data retrieval, record management, and workflow execution. Supports multiple authentication methods and tool packaging for role-based access control.

rawRecord.description: Enables Claude to interact with ServiceNow instances through the ServiceNow API, allowing data retrieval, record management, and workflow execution. Supports multiple authentication methods and tool packaging for role-based access control.

MCP_TOOL_PACKAGE.description: The tool package to load (e.g., 'service_desk', 'catalog_builder', 'full', 'none'). If not set, defaults to 'full'.

SERVICENOW_API_KEY.description: Your ServiceNow API key (required if SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=api_key)

SERVICENOW_PASSWORD.description: Your ServiceNow password for basic authentication

SERVICENOW_USERNAME.description: Your ServiceNow username for basic authentication

SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE.description: The authentication type to use: 'basic', 'oauth', or 'api_key'

SERVICENOW_CLIENT_ID.description: Your OAuth client ID (required if SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=oauth)

SERVICENOW_TOKEN_URL.description: The OAuth token URL (required if SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=oauth, e.g., https://your-instance.service-now.com/oauth_token.do)

SERVICENOW_INSTANCE_URL.description: The URL of your ServiceNow instance (e.g., https://your-instance.service-now.com)

SERVICENOW_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your OAuth client secret (required if SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE=oauth)
